title: A1 Intensive Course – August 2026 Applications Now Open!
excerpt: Applications are now open for our upcoming A1 Intensive German course starting August 2026. Apply now to secure your spot.
content: We are thrilled to announce that applications for our A1 Intensive German Language Course (August 2026 Batch) are now officially open. This is a 10-week intensive program designed for absolute beginners. Classes are held live online via Google Meet. The course fee is BDT 12,000. Admission is application-based, so don't miss this opportunity — apply now to start your German learning journey with GLAB's expert instructor.

title: New A1, A2 & B1 Batches Starting October 2026
excerpt: Six new batches across A1, A2, and B1 Intensive are opening for October 2026 — check the schedule and register your spot.
content:
GLAB is opening six new batches across all three levels, starting mid-October 2026. A1 Intensive is application-based via our online form; A2 and B1 Intensive are open to eligible existing students through the Registration Portal, with registration closing 10.09.2026.

A1 Intensive – 41st Batch (Morning): Sat + Sun, 7:00–10:00 AM (Germany time), 10 weeks, starts 17.10.2026
A1 Intensive – 42nd Batch (Evening): Tue + Fri, 6:00–9:00 PM (Germany time), 10 weeks, starts 20.10.2026

A2 Intensive – 38th Batch (Morning): Mon + Thu, 6:30–10:00 AM (Germany time), 8 weeks, starts 19.10.2026
A2 Intensive – 39th Batch (Evening): Wed + Sun, 6:00–9:30 PM (Germany time), 8 weeks, starts 21.10.2026

B1 Intensive – 34th Batch (Evening): Mon + Thu, 6:00–9:30 PM (Germany time), 8 weeks, starts 19.10.2026
B1 Intensive – 35th Batch (Morning): Tue + Fri, 6:30–9:30 AM (Germany time), 8 weeks, starts 20.10.2026

All batches are 2 days per week. Seats are limited — apply or register early to secure your spot.

title: Foundation + A1 Intensive – Applications Open!
excerpt: Applications are now open for GLAB's 41st Morning Batch and 42nd Evening Batch. Apply by 10.09.2026.
content:
Applications are now open for GLAB’s 41st Morning Batch and 42nd Evening Batch.

Application Deadline: 10.09.2026
Course Fee: 12,000 BDT

Apply here: https://glabeducation.com/apply/a1/

Note: If you are not the candidate, please do not apply on someone else's behalf. It is mandatory that applicants apply for themselves.
